fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: Identifies this Paystack account. The first enabled account is also reachable as the Payment Gateway "Paystack".

fields.label: Test Mode
fields.description: Required when the keys are Paystack test keys (sk_test_/pk_test_) and refused for live keys.

fields.label: Checkout Mode
fields.description: Inline opens the Paystack popup on this site's checkout page. Hosted redirects the payer to a Paystack-hosted page. Both are initialised on the server.

fields.label: Payment Link Validity (Hours)
fields.description: Hours a checkout link stays payable. 0 keeps links open indefinitely. A payment that reaches Paystack after the link closed still settles.

fields.label: Webhook Secret (optional override)
fields.description: Paystack signs webhooks with the account's Secret Key. Set this only if you verify webhooks with a different secret.

fields.label: Account Currency
fields.description: The currency this Paystack account settles in.

fields.label: Additional Currencies
fields.description: Other currencies this account is enabled for on Paystack (for example USD), separated by commas. Supported: NGN, GHS, ZAR, KES, USD, XOF.

fields.label: Allowed Webhook IPs
fields.description: Optional. One IP address or CIDR range per line; empty allows all. Paystack documents 52.31.139.75, 52.49.173.169 and 52.214.14.220; confirm at https://paystack.com/docs/payments/webhooks before relying on the list.

fields.label: Save Reusable Cards
fields.description: Store the reusable card authorization Paystack returns after a card payment, so the payer can be charged again (saved cards, subscriptions). Only enable this with the payer's consent.

fields.label: Register as its own Payment Gateway
fields.description: Also register this account as the Payment Gateway "Paystack-<Account Name>" so apps (for example LMS) can select it explicitly.
